text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — need alignment on MVP and launch criteria for multi-step/multi-call tool orchestration. Customer asks are piling up; want scope locked by EOD Friday.
jon (Eng): Quick question: are we optimizing for latency (chat UX) or for consistency (ordered side-effects)? Those push opposite designs.
maya (PM): Both. But customers prioritize low-latency chat first; many can accept eventual consistency if we offer clear guarantees. We should propose a minimal API.
li (ML): Parallel fanout = better median latency, worse tail. Also retried tool calls complicate model state (KV cache). We need clear semantics for duplicate side-effects.
fiona (SRE): Ops constraints: concurrent external calls multiply active connections and GPU memory pressure if we stream partials. Will need backpressure, per-customer rate limits, and per-request concurrency caps.
samira (Sales): Customer X: "3 step enrichment pipeline, must finish in <2s" — that's unrealistic for remote webhooks + heavy model inference. They asked about sync flow though.
jon (Eng): Proposed MVP modes (high-level):
- "best-effort-parallel" (async streaming partials + webhook callbacks): low-latency, no ordering guarantees for side-effects, idempotency required on integrator side.
- "ordered-sync" (strict sequential invoke inside request): strong ordering, higher latency and resource cost.
Which to prioritize?
maya (PM): Focus: ship best-effort-parallel first. Offer ordered-sync as opt-in later. Document tradeoffs clearly.
fiona (SRE): For best-effort-parallel we need these safeguards: per-tool timeout, global request timeout, per-route concurrency quota, and circuit breakers for hot third-party integrations.
jon (Eng): API sketch (informal):
```
POST /v1/chat/invoke
{ "mode": "parallel_best_effort", "tools": ["fetch_profile","call_billing","summarize"], "webhook_url": "https://example.com/cb" }
```
Response streams partial results; final completion posted as webhook if provided.
li (ML): Add Invocation metadata to reply: invocation_id, tool_attempts[], model_version, and a deterministic placeholder for missing tool outputs so evals can handle nondeterminism.
samira (Sales): Customers need signed webhook headers and retry headers for idempotency. Also explicit SLA language: "async delivery not guaranteed within X" unless they pay for dedicated capacity.
jon (Eng): Implementation notes: continuous batching + async IO for tool calls. Dev plan: first cut uses a task queue per-request with bounded concurrency; streaming connector to client and webhook writer. We must avoid holding KV cache locks while waiting on external HTTP.
fiona (SRE): Observability: must emit per-invocation metrics: total_latency, per-tool_latency, failure_reason (timeout, 5xx, auth), token_cost. Traces should link model inference span and external call spans.
maya (PM): Launch criteria proposal:
- API contract published + examples
- End-to-end test harness with mocked tools that covers 95% of golden prompt coverage
- Scalable to 50 concurrent best-effort requests on dedicated infra without >2x baseline p50 latency
- Telemetry and dashboards for per-tool failures and cost impact
- Webhook auth + retry semantics documented
- Security review complete
If any of these miss, we gate behind feature-flag rollout.
jon (Eng): Scope negotiation: defer ordered-sync, durable exactly-once side-effects, and multi-tenant transaction semantics to Q3. MVP = best-effort-parallel + streaming partials + webhook finalization + per-tool timeouts/idempotency docs.
samira (Sales): Happy enough if we ship auth + clear SLA and a migration path for ordered flows.
rls-bot: Deploy window reminder — cross-team deploy freeze Mon 03:00-06:00 UTC.
maya (PM): Action items:
- jon: RFC + schema PR for the API by Tue EOD
- fiona: perf/backpressure acceptance tests and dashboard by Wed
- li: eval harness with mocked tool failures by Thu
- samira: compile customer ask doc and prioritize 3 pilot customers
jon (Eng): Checklist I’ll track: [ ] API spec PR, [ ] runtime backpressure hooks, [ ] streaming client examples, [ ] webhook auth + retries, [ ] telemetry spans
maya (PM): OK — thanks all. I’ll draft the RFC and post in #eng-runtime for review. If nobody objects, we lock MVP scope: best-effort-parallel + async webhooks + per-tool timeouts + telemetry. :thumbsup:
